AgentCompass v0.3.6 adds a sha256-verified public reference data channel (schema 2), unifies routing and gate quota decisions on data-declared window scopes, drives `setup` from router discovery, adds Magpie gateway subscription pool aggregation with live refresh and hover breakdown, and ships a reusable foreign-machine verification harness.

- **Public reference data channel (`agentcompass data`)**: Installed copies stay current between releases by fetching sha256-verified `accounts.json`, `plan-templates.json`, and `classifier-cases.json` from `public-data.json` (schema 2) into `<state_dir>/public-data/sets/<version>`, reported in `agentcompass doctor` and controlled by `AGENTCOMPASS_PUBLIC_DATA=off`. Older schema-1 installs ignore schema-2 manifests and preserve their bundled set cleanly.
- **Clean-install fleet parity & public-data model checkbox defaults**: Dropped the machine-local `accounts.local.json` split so a clean install routes with the full calibrated reference fleet. Discovered models default to checked unless `accounts.json` marks them `superseded`; the user's model-management checkbox overrides both ways, and checked metered models remain a last-resort fallback when no subscription bundle is eligible.
- **Unified quota gate, data-driven window scope & running-owner control exemption**: `router_gate_hook.py` now delegates quota refusals to `allocator.launch_blockers` and `window_scope.py` (`models` / `models_except` declared in data, active in-flight reservations deducted, no private floor tables or `claude-2` name guessing). Parent control messages to an owned, currently `running` Paseo worker skip the quota check so wrap-up and handoff instructions are never blocked by an exhausted window.
- **Multi-account classifier cascade & Antigravity plan tier discovery**: System-One classification tries every usable signed-in account of each scorer family (`~/.claude-2`, `~/.codex-2`, Paseo custom homes) and records absent credentials in `skipped` without counting them as errors. Antigravity's subscription tier (`free` / `pro` / `ultra`) is read from Google Cloud Code `loadCodeAssist` using `agy`'s own sign-in token (`AGENTCOMPASS_ANTIGRAVITY_PLAN=off` to disable), and third-party windows price from the pool prior on template-only hosts.
- **Magpie subscription pools (`×N`), Tray cards & Usage Float parity**: Auto-discovered Magpie gateways refresh hours-old readings on `force=True` via `POST /v1/magpie/quotas/refresh`, aggregate all subscriptions of the largest plan (`pro ×2`, `7d×2`, `5h×2`), expose `N × (100 - mean)` remaining capacity to the router and gate, and show masked per-account hover breakdowns in both Tray account cards and Usage Float.
- **Unified `setup` / `provider_inventory` home discovery**: `setup/sync_host_globals.py` derives harness homes for rules, skills, and hooks directly from `provider_inventory.discover()` plus `FAMILY_SPECS`, preserves each secondary Claude/Codex home's own `settings.json` (`model`, `effortLevel`, `env`), and retires removed homes from `setup-manifest.json` on upgrade.

The Windows tray installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. See [packaging/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass/blob/v0.3.6/packaging/SIGNING.md).

Status: alpha. Customize the reference fleet and model calibration for your own subscriptions.
